newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize firm in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize firm in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize firmed in tight spot trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices squeezed by good export demand and tight supply, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Bahia Blanca firmed $2 to $115. Argentine grain sellers are reacting to recent price rises by hoping for more and holding on to their merchandise. Rosario spybeans firmed $2 to $295 in tight trade, following a firm near Chicago. Buenos Aires sunflower seed rose $4 to $220, fed by crusher demand and goodish oil prices. January wheat was unchanged at $155 in quiet trade.
